newsitem.title: ITALY: De Silguy appreciates Italy's efforts to join EMU.
newsitem.headline: De Silguy appreciates Italy's efforts to join EMU.

text.p: European commissioner for monetary affairs Yves-Thibault de Silguy said Italy had made significant efforts to meet Maastricht goals and these were beginning to bear fruit.
"I note with satisfaction the Italian government's efforts which are starting to bear fruit, as demonstrated by inflation and interest rates," he told a news conference here.

Italian CPI inflation has fallen steadily over the past year and currently stands at 2.4 percent. The Bank of Italy has reduced its official discount rate three times over the same period from 9.0 percent to 6.75 percent.
